verifiedAtPolicy: verifiedAt is the date of the last reconciliation that covered EVERY entry, not the freshest evidence in the file. A single-surface re-vet records its own date inside that entry's reason and deliberately does not move this field, so an entry reason may legitimately postdate verifiedAt; reading this field as the latest documented verification overstates what was checked.
historicalEvidencePolicy: Archived receipts, dated plans, prior releases, and old acceptance evidence are immutable history and are not repinned by this ledger.
integrityCoveragePolicy: An entry's integrity hash is assumed to cover the artifact that actually executes. When it does not — the distributed package is a launcher that fetches its real payload at run time — the entry must set integrityCovers to "launcher-only" and its reason must name the unrecorded hop. A launcher-only entry may not be declared egress "none" in src/mcp/servers.ts: provisioning is real egress even when steady-state operation is local.
